<a id="unused_draw_lives"></a>
### [`unused_draw_lives`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_5020.asm#L6) `$5020`

*routine*

Dead code: nothing calls it. Writes lives ($1d) to the screen at $0767 with colour 6. The panel routine at $51c0 uses $0777 now.

- **Reads:** [`lives`](../../memory-map.md#lives)
- **Writes:** [`VICSCN`](../../memory-map.md#VICSCN), `$DB67`
